name: Net sales
definition: Revenue after discounts, excluding tax; canonical revenue.
formula: SUM(fact_sales_lines.net_amount) == SUM(fact_invoices.net_total); POS Invoice docstatus=1, is_return=0
caveats: Both populations (Consolidated + Paid) count for revenue.
Never use Sales Invoice (consolidated copies double count).
net_total == grand_total today only because taxes are 0.

name: Bills
definition: Number of submitted, non-return POS Invoices.
caveats: 3177 on demo.

name: Average ticket (ATV)
definition: Net sales per bill.
formula: SUM(net_total) / COUNT(name) on fact_invoices (chart expr measure)
caveats: Ratio of totals, never AVG of per-bill ratios.
Mixes order types: filter Order type for like-for-like.

name: Daily net sales trend
definition: Net sales per calendar day.
caveats: Demo gap Oct 2025-Mar 2026 shows as empty days.

name: Latest day vs previous day
definition: Latest period net sales with delta vs the previous period.
formula: Number chart, y SUM(net_total), date posting_date granularity day, comparison true
caveats: Insights compares to the previous period, not the same weekday last week (owner brief slide 1 uses D-8; PWA computes that).

name: Month-to-date net sales
definition: Net sales of the latest month with delta vs previous month.
formula: Number chart, y SUM(net_total), date posting_date granularity month, comparison true
caveats: Previous month is a full month; MTD-vs-MTD needs the PWA.

name: Channel mix (order type)
definition: Net sales and bills by order_type.
caveats: Aggregators = 4 bills on demo; customer 'Swiggy' appears on all types (do not use customer as channel).

name: Sales by hour of day
definition: Bills and net sales per hour of posting_time.
caveats: posting_time = order start (draft creation) for dine-in, not bill time.
Prefer population=Paid for realistic shape.

name: Weekday x hour demand grid
definition: Bills per weekday and hour.
formula: Table rows weekday, columns hour_of_day, COUNT(name) on fact_invoices
caveats: No heatmap type: Table pivot.

name: Sales by branch
definition: Net sales per branch.
caveats: Demo has 1 branch and 1 company: structurally ready, renders a single bar.

name: Zero-value bills
definition: Submitted bills with grand_total = 0 (comps or test bills).
caveats: 18 on demo; no comp reason captured.

name: Covers (dine-in)
definition: Guests served on dine-in bills.
formula: SUM(fact_invoices.pax) where order_type='Dine In' and population='Paid'
caveats: no_of_pax is text, cast; pax also filled on take-away (junk).
Paid population only: Consolidated rows carry a synthetic waiter (urycashier) and pax 0.
Demo pax 1-6 uniform-random.

name: Spend per cover
definition: Dine-in net sales per guest.
formula: SUM(net_total) / SUM(pax) on fact_invoices, order_type='Dine In', pax > 0, population='Paid'
caveats: Null where covers = 0; do not coalesce to 0.
Paid population only: Consolidated rows carry a synthetic waiter (urycashier) and pax 0.

name: Returns value
definition: Value of return/credit-note invoices.
formula: SUM(grand_total) where POS Invoice is_return=1 (not in facts: facts exclude returns)
caveats: 0 returns ever recorded; facts filter is_return=0 by design.

name: Service charge and tips
definition: Service charge or tip income.
formula: SUM(Sales Taxes and Charges.tax_amount) for a service-charge account; no tip field
caveats: No tip field exists; taxes are 0 on all bills.

name: Self-order (QR/kiosk) share
definition: Share of bills originating from QR/kiosk sessions.
formula: COUNT(URY Ordering Session with invoice) / COUNT(bills)
caveats: URY Ordering Session has 0 rows.

name: Sales vs monthly target
definition: Net sales of the month against the monthly target set for the branch; the current month is month to date against the full-month target.
formula: SUM(POS Invoice.net_total) per branch between URY Sales Target.period_start and period_end / URY Sales Target.target_amount
caveats: Only branches with a URY Sales Target row appear (demo: URY Branch, 7 months).
Current month is month to date, so it reads low until the month ends; closed months are shown separately.

name: Item revenue
definition: Net sales per item.

name: Item quantity sold
definition: Units sold per item.

name: Top 10 items by revenue
definition: Best sellers by net sales.

name: Bottom 10 sold items by revenue
definition: Weakest sellers among items that sold at least once.
caveats: Items with zero sales never appear here: see MNU-011.

name: Category revenue (cleaned)
definition: Net sales per cleaned menu category (CATEGORY_MAP v1).
caveats: Raw item_group is flat and polluted ('All Item Groups' holds 11.4%); always use menu_category.

name: Category family mix
definition: Food vs Beverage vs Non-menu vs Unassigned share of net sales.

name: Item x category table
definition: Qty, revenue and share per item within category.
formula: Table rows menu_category, item_name; SUM(qty), SUM(net_amount) on fact_sales_lines_enriched

name: Beverage attach rate
definition: Share of bills that include at least one beverage line.
formula: COUNT_DISTINCT(invoice) where category_family='Beverage' / COUNT_DISTINCT(invoice) on fact_sales_lines_enriched (two Number tiles; ratio stated in text)
caveats: Cannot express a conditional distinct ratio in one chart on 3.15.1 (distinct_count_if unverified): two tiles.

name: Non-selling items
definition: Sales items that never sold.
formula: COUNT(dim_item) where is_sales_item=1 and is_sold=0 and disabled=0
caveats: Item master mixes raw materials and menu items; menu membership is on URY Menu, not Item.

name: Menu engineering (popularity x margin)
definition: Qty sold vs estimated unit margin per costed item.
formula: Table: item_name, SUM(qty), SUM(est_margin)/SUM(qty) on fact_sales_lines_enriched where cost_known=1
caveats: Only items with a default BOM cost (6-8% of revenue).

name: Revenue by configured department
definition: Net sales attributed to the department configured to make each item.
caveats: 17.4% of revenue is 'Unmapped' (62 items without department).
Configured department, not the unit that cooked it (differs on 74/203 KOT lines).

name: Revenue by kitchen warehouse
definition: Made-to-order (Kitchen) vs pre-produced (Finished Goods) sales.
caveats: Only 2 warehouse values.

name: Revenue by production policy
definition: Sales by PRE_PRODUCED / MADE_TO_ORDER / DIRECT_RETAIL.
caveats: Null for unconfigured items.

name: KOTs by executed unit
definition: Kitchen tickets per production unit that received them.
caveats: 132 KOTs on demo; dates sparse except 2026-10-21.

name: Kitchen quantity by unit
definition: Dish quantity sent to each unit.
caveats: quantity is text, cast.

name: Bulk production cost
definition: Cost of batch production runs.
caveats: Bulk Production has 0 rows.

name: Plan attainment %
definition: Share of planned quantity actually fulfilled.
caveats: fulfilled_qty is a running counter with no history.

name: Planned quantity
definition: Units planned for production.
caveats: Units are Nos/Unit; never sum across UOM.

name: Under-production
definition: Planned units not fulfilled (per line, before aggregation).
caveats: 114 of 131 lines under.

name: Over-production
definition: Units fulfilled beyond plan.
caveats: Netting with PLN-004 hides overs: keep split.

name: Attainment by department
definition: Which kitchen misses plan.
caveats: department == production_unit on every plan line (5 values).

name: Attainment by service period and enforcement
definition: Lunch vs dinner; Hard vs Soft vs Alert plans.

name: Committed vs fulfilled
definition: Open reservations against plan.
caveats: committed_qty = 0 on all 131 lines.

name: Plan vs POS units sold
definition: Planned qty vs units actually sold for the same item and date.
formula: Side-by-side: SUM(fact_sales_plan_items.qty) by item_code and SUM(fact_sales_lines.qty) by item_code for the same date filter; never row-join
caveats: Builder joins cannot pre-aggregate two facts; show two charts with the same filters.

name: Plan-controlled item coverage
definition: Items whose production obeys the sales plan.
caveats: 169 of 202 configured items.

name: KOTs fired
definition: Kitchen tickets submitted.

name: Ticket time (legacy production minutes)
definition: Average KOT creation-to-serve minutes from KOT.production_time.
formula: AVG(prod_minutes) on fact_kot_headers with chart filter is_served = 1
caveats: Stored in MINUTES though shipped reports say seconds.
36 seeded rows = 12.0 and 4 = 20.0: demo shape is synthetic.

name: KOT SLA breach rate
definition: Share of served KOTs over the POS Profile target (custom_kot_warning_time: 15 min URY, 10 min URY Branch).
caveats: Target is per POS Profile, not per unit/course.
100% on demo (seeded 12/20 min).

name: Prep time (start to ready)
definition: Minutes from IN_PREPARATION to READY.
caveats: Demo stamps are milliseconds apart (median 0.004 s): show empty-state, not a chart.

name: Queue wait (fired to started)
definition: Minutes a ticket waits before cooking starts.
caveats: No queued_at field; Execution.creation is a proxy and seeded back-dated (median 87.6 min): do not publish.

name: Order-to-serve (guest wait)
definition: Minutes from KOT fired (date+time) to served_at.
caveats: KOT time back-dated in seed: 34 min..5.7 h meaningless on demo.

name: Kitchen throughput funnel
definition: Executions started, ready, served.
caveats: Counts are valid even though durations are not (deduped: 93 KOTs).

name: Cancellations by kitchen stage
definition: Cancelled before start / after start / after ready.
formula: COUNT(name) by state where is_cancelled=1 on fact_kot_exec
caveats: 6 rows on demo.

name: Open tickets
definition: KOTs not yet served within the selected dates.
caveats: Must be date-bounded; old 2025 KOTs never closed.

name: Order modification rate
definition: Share of KOTs that are 'Order Modified'.
formula: COUNT where type='Order Modified' / COUNT(name) on fact_kot_headers (chart filter tile + total tile)
caveats: KOT.user is a display name, not a user id.

name: Kitchen line voids
definition: Quantity cancelled on KOT lines.
caveats: 8 of 203 lines.

name: Void disposition
definition: Cancelled qty by fate (Returned to Stock / Wasted).
caveats: disposition = Pending on 203/203.

name: KOT load by hour
definition: Tickets per hour of KOT.time.
caveats: hour(KOT.time) verified working.

name: Item prep speed
definition: Slowest dishes, start to ready per KOT line.
formula: AVG(ready_at - started_at) on URY KOT Item Execution by item (not in semantic layer)
caveats: Milliseconds on demo; add fact_kot_item_exec (sql) when stamps are real.

name: Tables occupied now
definition: Dining tables currently flagged occupied.
formula: SUM(occupied) and COUNT(name) on dim_table where is_take_away=0
caveats: Live flag, no history; snapshot only.

name: Dine-in bills
definition: Submitted dine-in invoices.
caveats: 995 on demo.

name: Table turns per day
definition: Dine-in bills per table per day.
formula: count(name) / distinct_count(restaurant_table) per posting_date on fact_table_sessions (expr measure) where is_take_away=0
caveats: ~1.2 on demo; not a meaningful demo number.

name: Order-open-to-pay dwell
definition: Average minutes from invoice creation to payment, valid rows only.
formula: AVG(dwell_minutes) on fact_table_sessions with chart filter dwell_valid=1
caveats: Not seat-to-clear: excludes pre-order wait and clearing.
502/995 are 00:00:00; the rest cluster at 30 min (seeded).

name: Revenue by table
definition: Dine-in net sales per table.
caveats: Exclude is_take_away=1 tables (162 dine-in bills sit on Takeaway/Waiting tables).

name: Revenue by room
definition: Dine-in net sales per room (URY Table.restaurant_room).
caveats: Uses the table master room, not the half-empty invoice room field.

name: Over-capacity parties
definition: Dine-in bills whose pax exceeds table seats.
caveats: 104 breaches are seed noise.

name: RevPASH / covers per seat-hour
definition: PROXY: dine-in net sales (and covers) per available seat-hour, where available seat-hours = seats of enabled non-takeaway tables x that weekday's opening hours.
formula: SUM(dine-in net_total) / SUM(SUM(URY Table.no_of_seats) x open hours of the day), days with dine-in trade
caveats: Proxy: capacity is tables x scheduled opening hours, not live seat occupancy.
Needs a URY Branch Operating Schedule per branch; branches without one are absent.
Days with no dine-in bill are not counted as available seat-hours.

name: Seat-to-clear dwell and utilisation
definition: PROXY: time at table (bill created to bill paid, total_spend_time) per room, and table occupancy = time at table / (tables x opening hours).
formula: AVG(total_spend_time) for 0 < time <= 8 h; SUM(time at table) / SUM(tables x open hours)
caveats: Proxy: not seated-to-cleared; bills without a recorded time are left out.
Occupancy is a floor estimate because time before the bill is created is not captured.

name: Bill / assistance response time
definition: Minutes from guest request to resolution.
formula: AVG(resolved_at - requested_at) on fact_service_requests where status='Resolved' (needs sql TIMESTAMPDIFF when used)
caveats: 4 rows; no acknowledged_at.

name: Sales per waiter
definition: Net sales per waiter user (Paid population).
caveats: Employee = Frappe User (waiter), not HR Employee.
Paid population only: Consolidated rows carry a synthetic waiter (urycashier) and pax 0.

name: Bills per waiter
definition: Bills owned per waiter.
caveats: Paid population only: Consolidated rows carry a synthetic waiter (urycashier) and pax 0.

name: Average ticket per waiter
definition: Net sales per bill per waiter.
caveats: Compare within the same order type.

name: Covers per waiter
definition: Dine-in guests served per waiter.
formula: SUM(pax) by waiter where order_type='Dine In' and population='Paid'
caveats: pax uniform-random on demo.

name: Spend per cover per waiter
definition: Upsell indicator.
formula: SUM(net_total)/SUM(pax) by waiter, Dine In, pax>0, population='Paid'
caveats: Null where pax 0.

name: Category mix per waiter
definition: Revenue per waiter split by category family.
formula: SUM(net_amount) by waiter split_by category_family on fact_sales_lines_enriched where population='Paid'

name: Cancellations per waiter
definition: Cancelled bills and value per order owner.
formula: COUNT(name), SUM(grand_total) by waiter on fact_cancellations
caveats: Waiter is the order owner, not necessarily the canceller.

name: Sales per cashier
definition: Net sales settled per cashier user.
caveats: Cashier is populated on 100% of bills, incl. Consolidated.

name: Cash-up variance per cashier
definition: Till difference per closing user.
caveats: difference = 0 on all 308 rows; all closings by urycashier.

name: Discount given per cashier
definition: Discount value per cashier.
caveats: 4 discounted bills on demo.

name: Labour cost % of sales
definition: Employee costs over net sales (Daily P and L).
caveats: Attendance-prorated wages, seeded; no per-person split.

name: Cook speed per user
definition: Prep minutes per cook (started_by/ready_by).
caveats: All kitchen actors are Administrator; durations ms.

name: Sales per labour hour
definition: Branch net sales per hour of staff attendance (Attendance.working_hours of Present staff), for days that have both sales and attendance.
formula: SUM(POS Invoice.net_total) / SUM(Attendance.working_hours), joined by branch (Employee.branch) and date
caveats: Branch-level only: sales of all staff against attendance of staff who have attendance rows.
Days with sales but no attendance (or the reverse) are excluded.

name: Tips and commission per waiter
definition: Tips entered at billing per waiter (POS Invoice.custom_tip_amount by custom_waiter_employee). Commission is not charted.
caveats: Partial: tips only. Commission is calculated by the Commission report in the app and is not stored on any table.
Tips depend on staff entering the tip at billing.

name: Tendered amount
definition: Money received across tenders on POS bills.
caveats: parenttype='POS Invoice' mandatory (SIP also holds Sales Invoice rows).
Includes change given back: see PAY-004.

name: Payment mode mix
definition: Share of tender by mode of payment.

name: Payment mode by order type
definition: Tender mix per channel.

name: Collected vs billed
definition: Paid minus change vs rounded total; should match.
formula: SUM(paid_amount) - SUM(change_amount) vs SUM(rounded_total) on fact_invoices
caveats: Matches to the rupee on demo (3,754,042).

name: Expected vs counted at close
definition: System expected vs counted per day.
formula: SUM(expected_amount), SUM(closing_amount) by posting_date on fact_closing_details
caveats: Closings cover only Consolidated invoices.

name: Cash-up variance
definition: Sum and count of non-zero till differences.
caveats: 0 on all 308 rows: 'All tills balanced' is the honest message.

name: Unclosed sales
definition: Net sales on Paid bills not yet in any POS Closing Entry.
caveats: 1,498,040 in 1075 bills on demo.

name: Gross profit (Daily P and L)
definition: Gross profit as submitted on URY Daily P and L.
caveats: Seeded; COGS from BOM x buying price covers few items, so optimistic.

name: Gross margin % (Daily P and L)
definition: Gross profit over net sales.
caveats: Never AVG(gross_profit_percent).

name: Food cost % (Daily P and L)
definition: COGS over net sales.
caveats: cogs > 0 on 52 of 116 submitted docs.

name: Net profit (Daily P and L)
definition: Profit after employee and other costs.

name: Recipe cost coverage %
definition: Share of revenue whose items have a default BOM cost.
caveats: Must be shown next to every T2 margin number (~6-8% on demo).

name: Estimated margin (costed items)
definition: Net sales minus qty x BOM unit cost, costed lines only.
caveats: BOM raw_material_cost at BOM rates; ignores yield (BOM yield fields 0).

name: Estimated margin % (costed items)
definition: Estimated margin over costed revenue.
caveats: Not representative of the whole menu.

name: Estimated food cost by category
definition: Estimated cost and margin per menu_category.
formula: SUM(est_cost), SUM(est_margin) by menu_category where cost_known=1

name: Accounting food cost % (GL)
definition: COGS GL debit over sales GL credit.
formula: SUM(GL debit 'Cost of Goods Sold') / SUM(GL credit 'Sales')
caveats: 91% of sales stock movements valued at 0; POS Invoice posts no GL; single cost center.

name: Actual consumption cost (stock ledger)
definition: Value of stock consumed by sales and issues.
formula: SUM(-stock_value_difference) on SLE for Sales Invoice/Material Issue
caveats: Raw materials are not depleted by POS sales; warehouses carry no branch.

name: Theoretical vs counted cost variance
definition: BOM theoretical cost vs counted cost per item.
formula: SUM(variance_vs_theoretical), SUM(variance_vs_counted) on URY Cost Variance Snapshot
caveats: 8 seeded rows, company only; not in semantic layer.

name: Wastage value
definition: Value of authorised wastage.
caveats: URY Wastage has 0 rows: empty-state.

name: Wastage quantity by item
definition: Wasted units per item.
caveats: 0 rows; never sum across UOM.

name: Wastage by reason
definition: Wastage value by reason_category.
caveats: 0 rows.

name: Wastage by department
definition: Wastage value per production department.
caveats: 0 rows.

name: Wastage % of sales
definition: Wastage value over net sales, same branch and period.
formula: WST-001 / SAL-001 (two tiles, same filters; never row-join)
caveats: 0 rows.

name: Wasted-prep cancellations (proxy)
definition: Kitchen executions cancelled after cooking started or finished.
caveats: Count only, no cost (6 rows).

name: Shrinkage value
definition: Counted below book (negative count variance).
caveats: Use child amount_difference; header difference_amount is 0 on 20/20.

name: Overage value
definition: Counted above book.

name: Net count variance
definition: Net value of all count corrections.
caveats: +204.0 on demo: netting hides 29,970 gross.

name: Count variance % of stock value
definition: Gross absolute variance over book value counted.
caveats: About 2.5% on demo.

name: Variance by item
definition: Shrink and overage per item.
caveats: Only 6 raw-material items counted.

name: Days of cover
definition: Stock on hand over average daily outflow.
caveats: POS sales do not deplete raw materials; no recipe backflush.

name: Weighted actual yield %
definition: Usable output over input across checks.
caveats: Never AVG(actual_yield_percent); never mix Kg and Litre.
Rows over 100% exist (allowed by design).

name: Standard yield %
definition: Weighted standard yield of the same checks.
caveats: Snapshot fixed at first save of each check.

name: Yield gap vs standard (points)
definition: Actual minus standard yield, percentage points.
caveats: Points, not relative %.

name: Yield loss quantity
definition: Output short of standard.
caveats: Negative = gain.

name: Checks below standard
definition: Share of checks under standard.

name: Out-of-tolerance rate
definition: Share of checks more than 5 points under standard.
caveats: Tolerance (5 points) is an architecture constant, not a stored field.

name: Yield trend
definition: Weekly weighted yield per item.
caveats: 22 days of checks on demo.

name: Yield by department
definition: Weighted yield per production department.
caveats: department and production_unit empty on 66/66.

name: Yield loss cost
definition: Value of output short of standard.
caveats: Needs a rate join (Bin/Stock Correction Item) not in the layer.

name: Yield check compliance
definition: Checks done vs expected by cadence.
caveats: Expected-count rule lives in code (yield_check_reminders.py).

name: Cancelled bills
definition: Count of cancelled POS Invoices.
caveats: 60 on demo.

name: Cancelled value
definition: Value of cancelled bills.
caveats: 87,680 on demo.

name: Cancellation rate (value)
definition: Cancelled value over submitted plus cancelled value.

name: Cancellations by reason
definition: Cancelled bills by reason.
caveats: Free text; 5 values on demo, messy in production.

name: Cancellations by order type
definition: Where cancellations happen.

name: Discount value and bills
definition: Bill discounts given.
caveats: 4 bills, 31.89 total on demo; line discounts 0; staff discount policy unused.

name: Out-of-stock cancellations
definition: Bills cancelled because the kitchen ran out.
formula: COUNT(name) where cancel_reason='Kitchen out of stock'
caveats: Links planning misses to lost sales (13 on demo).

name: Invoice population split
definition: Bills and net sales by population (Consolidated vs Paid).
formula: COUNT(name), SUM(net_total) by population on fact_invoices
caveats: 2102 Consolidated / 1075 Paid on demo.

name: Revenue with no department
definition: Share of net sales whose item has no configured department.
formula: SUM(net_amount) where department='Unmapped' / SUM(net_amount) on fact_sales_lines_enriched
caveats: 17.4% on demo.

name: Revenue in unassigned category
definition: Share of net sales in the root 'All Item Groups'.
caveats: 11.4% on demo (9 items).

name: Dine-in bills with covers
definition: Share of dine-in bills with pax > 0.
formula: COUNT where pax>0 / COUNT, order_type='Dine In', by population on fact_invoices
caveats: 512 of 995 on demo.

name: Dine-in bills with valid dwell
definition: Share of dine-in bills with 0 < dwell <= 8 h.
caveats: 493 of 995 non-zero, seeded.

name: Bills with waiter Employee link
definition: Share of bills whose waiter maps to an HR Employee.
formula: COUNT where custom_waiter_employee set / COUNT on fact_invoices (chart filter is_set)
caveats: Employee.user_id set on 2 of 8 employees.

name: Items with recipe cost
definition: Sold items with a default BOM cost.
formula: COUNT(dim_item) where is_sold=1 and has_recipe_cost=1 vs is_sold=1
caveats: 39 BOM dishes vs 181 sold items.

name: Kitchen actor capture
definition: Share of kitchen executions whose actor is a real user (not Administrator).
formula: COUNT where started_by not in ('Administrator', null) / COUNT on fact_kot_exec
caveats: 0% on demo.

name: Yield checks with department
definition: Share of yield checks with department set.
formula: COUNT where department is set / COUNT on fact_yield_checks

name: Wastage documents recorded
definition: Count of submitted wastage lines in period.
caveats: 0: the main T4 blocker for DB11.

name: Branches and companies with data
definition: Distinct branches and companies on bills.
caveats: 1 and 1: multi-branch comparisons are T3.
